address: 1-5 Bloomberg Arcade, City of London, London, EC4N 8AR, United Kingdom
bio: The army mess clubs of India provide the theme for this large restaurant spread across several rooms on the ground floor of the Bloomberg building. The cooking has a strong live fire element, blending street food dishes and those cooked on the barbecue, like the delicious goat tikki bun kebab. 'Feast' menus are available if you're in a big group and there's a decent selection of beers and whiskies too. It's a perennially busy place and they have several screens for showing sport, so the atmosphere is predictably loud and lively....
